mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace_role WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY name, id
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_role SET name = #{name} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_role WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_role_permission (workspace_role_id, permission) SELECT wr.id, vals.permission FROM workspace_role wr JOIN ( SELECT #{permission} AS permission ) vals WHERE wr.id = #{roleId} AND wr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
